sitedescription: From Tier-1 Support to Enterprise Systems Architect — driven by C# tooling, PowerShell automation, and infrastructure optimization.

description.desc: Began in L1 support at Getronics, rapidly advancing to a multi-account Shared Desk servicing major enterprise clients including a Fortune 100 industrial tech conglomerate, and a tier-1 global bank amongs others. Applied bilingual fluency (Native German, Fluent English) and intuitive root-cause analysis to resolve complex technical issues.

Elevated to L2 Technical Lead at HP, steering support operations for Monier and Panasonic. Specialized in deciphering systemic infrastructure issues from minimal diagnostics and mentoring cross-functional team members.

Transitioned to L3 infrastructure support at HPE dedicated to SKF. Managed SCCM architecture, Group Policies, and enterprise scripts. Optimized logon/startup scripts using VBScript and Batch to significantly reduce boot times and implemented standardized endpoint logging. Modernized GPO architecture using Loopback Processing (LSAD) and GPO Preferences, establishing dedicated test OU structures to ensure targeted policy enforcement.

Engineered custom object-oriented VB.NET GUI tools at DXC Technology to automate remote Active Directory management and bulk-endpoint remediation for SKF, drastically cutting resolution times. Served as a Technical Trainer, developing curriculum to upskill teams in Advanced PowerShell automation, VBScripting, T-SQL Reporting, and GPO optimization.

Appointed Technical Lead at Evosoft within the Siemens domain. Modernized software packaging by introducing the PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT) to standardize deployment workflows. Engineered a dynamic AD-group-driven automation framework to trigger targeted logon/startup scripts globally, integrating automated completion-time logging to drive domain-wide performance optimization.

Owned OS Deployment (OSD) and Windows In-Place Upgrade pipelines at DXC supporting a major European automotive manufacturer. Engineered custom WinPE HTA tools for pre-PXE customization and architected Zero-Touch Installations (ZTI). Handled physical datacenter rack installations while managing VMware Horizon VDI infrastructure—authoring optimized master images and maintaining storage redundancy across virtualized environments.

description.role: 2022 – Present: Enterprise Web Applications & C#.NET Engineering | CGF
description.desc: Lead developer at CGF managing an in-house ASP.NET MVC deployment platform for a major European automotive manufacturer. Engineered direct API/SDK integrations with Matrix42 Enterprise Manager and SCCM inside Visual Studio Enterprise, enabling real-time application deployment tasks that trigger immediate endpoint agent installations—bypassing traditional SCCM/Intune polling delays while managing full-stack C# backend logic, database operations, and frontend UI.
Engineered a centralized VBScript master controller that automatically orchestrates and executes child scripts (VBScript and Batch) placed within designated target directories.

Implemented dynamic membership checking that cross-references the client computer's AD groups against script filenames (omitting extension) to conditionally run targeted scripts only for authorized endpoints.
Enforced a uniform script template across all modules, automatically writing local client log files to streamline troubleshooting during execution failures.
Integrated a centralized execution log that calculates individual script runtimes and outputs total elapsed time per session to benchmark and optimize overall user logon duration.

dropdownItems.title: SCCM & Matrix42 Infrastructure Health Tester
dropdownItems.description: An automated PowerShell diagnostic tool scheduled for daily morning execution to evaluate core endpoint infrastructure health. It performs automated WMI connectivity verification between managed servers and the SCCM environment, while simultaneously scanning Matrix42 Enterprise Manager event logs for operational errors. Upon detecting system anomalies, the framework automatically triggers alerts to the central enterprise monitoring platform and initiates automated IT Service Management ticket creation for immediate engineering remediation.

dropdownItems.title: PC Information Tool (v1.01)
dropdownItems.description:
Distributed to enterprise endpoint devices to empower end-users with instant self-service system visibility. Aggregates critical General, Hardware, and Network parameters (IP, MAC, Serial, OS version) into a clear interface.

Features a prominent 'Copy Information to clipboard' action to eliminate ticket back-and-forth by letting users instantly paste diagnostics into support requests. Includes built-in Quick-Fix, Software inventory, and Diagnostic tabs for automated issue remediation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/pc-info-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Ultimate Active Directory Search Tool (UADST)
dropdownItems.description:
Streamlined administrative utility designed as a lightweight alternative to native Active Directory Users and Computers (ADUC). Enables rapid object discovery across Users, Computers, and Groups within the domain.

Features customizable 'Column Select' controls to extract only relevant AD attributes (e.g., operatingSystem, lastLogonTimestamp), secondary filtering options, and group membership lookups. Includes one-click output export and clipboard copying complete with headers for easy documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-query-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: IT - Ping & Remote Action Tool
dropdownItems.description:
Multi-threaded reachability and remote administration utility for helpdesk and sysadmins. Allows bulk monitoring of computer lists, resolving real-time IP addresses, Online/Offline status, and FQDNs.

Selecting any target host automatically populates the quick-action panel to execute instant remote administration tasks: pull detailed system info via WMI ('Get Info'), open the administrative share ('Open C$'), or spawn a remote PowerShell session ('PSSession').

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ping-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Active Directory Security Group Updater
dropdownItems.description:
Bulk administration utility built to perform safe, high-speed Active Directory security group membership updates. Enables administrators to add or remove multiple target user/computer objects across multiple groups simultaneously in a single execution pass.

Includes a dedicated real-time Error Handling & Reporting Grid that tracks individual operation statuses (e.g., User Added, User Not Found, Already a Member). Provides immediate visual confirmation and instant audit feedback for ticket documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-security-group-updater.html

Built with a lightweight, data-driven architecture that completely separates layout from content. All site metadata, navigation buttons, and tool project entries are stored externally in a structured data.json file.

Engineered using HTML5 and Tailwind CSS v4 for a responsive, dark-mode dashboard. Utilizes utility-first CSS components to maintain consistent typography, button states, and hover effects across desktop and mobile devices.

Powered by a custom vanilla JavaScript engine (app.js) that fetches data.json asynchronously on page load to dynamically render interface elements, populate project details, and build interactive dropdown context menus.
Zero-framework overhead delivering instant page loads. Version-controlled on GitHub and deployed via GitHub Pages with custom domain integration (jjim.dev).
